title: Command-bus validation compares uncoerced alloc values, breaking the documented deterministic no-op contract for mistyped commands
detail: apply_command is the declared validation boundary and promises invalid commands are deterministic no-ops, but alloc[lane] <= 0 compares the raw value after int()-casting elsewhere; a non-numeric element (e.g. String, Dictionary) causes a runtime type error aborting the command instead of a clean no-op.
recommended_fix: Normalize once up front: after the range loop, build validated = [int(alloc[0]), int(alloc[1]), int(alloc[2])] and use only validated (or pre-type-check each element with typeof(v) == TYPE_INT/FLOAT) before any comparison.
